resources.string: Add dark artwork to recognized static and layered icons, keeping text readable and existing animation intact.

Existing author dark behavior takes priority. Where the background can be identified reliably, derive a dark plate and keep neutral glyphs readable; otherwise use conservative dimming or retain the original. Supported dynamic groups keep their layers, timing and events. Complex Lottie and procedural artwork remain unchanged. This is derived artwork, not Monet. Results are cached; regenerate and apply after changing options. The dynamic-dark count does not include static icons.
Supported ordinary icons stay dark in light mode.
Turn on icon light/dark adaptation first.

Generate one dark image per supported ordinary icon for smoother launcher transitions. These icons stay dark in light mode. Calendars and clocks keep their own appearance and animation. Generate and apply again after changes.
Keep original layers, native animation and existing dark behavior. No additional derived dark artwork is generated.
Add dark artwork to supported icons. Generate and apply again.

Adapt recognized backgrounds, text and layered icons such as calendars and clocks while retaining their animation. Existing dark resources take priority; uncertain artwork is retained or conservatively dimmed. Results use additional resources and cache space. Generate and apply again after changes.
Preview shows still images for the current options, not live animation or the last generated or applied pack. Generate and apply again after changing options.
